major_issues.issue: 正文（物理页 8）原文将 DBAT 列为位于染色体 10 的 7 个已知基因之一，但 Figure 3B（物理页 30）实际将 DBAT 绘制于 Chr9。草稿同时给出两种归属：在主结果分析部分按原文文本称 7 个基因（含 DBAT）位于 Chr10，在 Figure 3B 描述部分又称 DBAT 位于 Chr9，存在内部不一致。
major_issues.source_locator: PDF 物理页 8 line 182-186 vs PDF 物理页 30 Figure 3B
major_issues.correction: 如需忠实复现原文叙述，应明确指出该差异：文本与 Figure 3B 在 DBAT 定位上不一致；草稿应二选一并加注，或者按图示以 Chr9=DBAT、Chr10 包含 TS/T5α/T10βOH/T2α/T7βOH（6 个已知基因）为准。如坚持文本版本则需标注此为正文叙述而非图示。

minor_issues: Figure 3B 描述中将 T13αOH 列入 Chr10 基因簇，但 Figure 3B 图像实际显示 T13αOH 与 DBAT 共同位于 Chr9 段。草稿应与所引图示保持一致（依据图像）或明确标注该差异。
正文数字 '44,008'（Results）与 '44,408'（Methods）原文不一致，草稿已主动指出并以 Results 为准，处理得当；但若进一步核对最终出版版（VoR）应避免数字误差。
Fig 2D 热图坐标轴标签部分被压缩，裁剪图仍完整，但读者需结合 Figure 2 legend 解读家族名称；草稿分析无误。
Hi-C 数据量在 Results（1077.1 Gb）与 Methods（约 1 Tb）略有出入；草稿采用 Methods 表述，属可接受范围。

verified_claims.claim: 10.9 Gb 基因组，12 条染色体，contig N50 8.6 Mb，scaffold N50 987 Mb
verified_claims.evidence: We obtained a total size of 10.9 Gb high quality genome containing 12 chromosomes (contig N50 of 8.6 Mb and scaffold N50 of 987 Mb)
the peak of the 17-mer distribution is 48, and the total K-mer count is 509,993,117,838… the genome size was estimated…as 10.62Gb

verified_claims.claim: 44,008 蛋白编码基因；2,796 非编码 RNA（含 505 miRNA、689 rRNA、1090 tRNA、512 snRNA）
verified_claims.evidence: we predicted 44,008 protein-coding genes and 2,796 non-coding RNA genes (i.e., 505 microRNAs (miRNA), 689 ribosomal RNAs (rRNA), 1,090 transfer RNAs (tRNA), and 512 small nuclear RNA (snRNA))

verified_claims.claim: BUSCO 1,614 embryophyta 核心基因 85% 可比对
verified_claims.evidence: 85% core genes of 1,614 embryophyta could be mapped into the genome by BUSCO… evaluation

verified_claims.claim: 22 个 synteny block，304 基因（约 0.69%）；Ks 峰值 52 Mya（Ks=0.28）
verified_claims.evidence: we only detected 22 synteny blocks including 304 genes (~0.69% of total genes) (Figure 1) and these synteny blocks showed a peak around 52 Mya (Ks = 0.28)

verified_claims.claim: 约 15,673 个串联复制基因；与 G. biloba / S. giganteum 一对一同源 56% 和 72%
verified_claims.evidence: we found that 56% and 72% genes in T. wallichiana had one-to-one synteny orthologs with G. biloba and S. giganteum respectively… 15,673 genes resulted from gene tandem duplication

verified_claims.claim: 重复基因与单拷贝基因内含子数差异 2.6 vs 4.3，P=1e-73；反转录转座复制仅 9%；约 8% 串联复制基因 dN/dS>1
verified_claims.evidence: average number of introns in duplicated genes was significantly less than that in single-copy genes (2.6 vs 4.3, P = 1e-73)… we only detected 9% gene duplications belonging to RNA-based retrotransposition… about 8% tandem duplicative genes in T. wallichiana displayed an excess rate of nonsynonymous substitution to synonymous substitution (dN/dS > 1)

verified_claims.claim: 616 个显著扩张基因家族；TPS002、CYP725、TRF004 在 T. wallichiana 中显著扩张
verified_claims.evidence: 616 gene families have significantly expanded in the T. wallichiana genome (Figure 2D)… three gene families involving in paclitaxel biosynthesis (terpene synthase family TPS002, cytochrome P450 family CYP725 and transferase family TRF004), dramatically expanded

verified_claims.claim: 11 个已知紫杉醇基因中 7 个（TS、T5αOH、T10βOH、T2αOH、T7βOH、T13αOH、DBAT）位于 Chr10；CYP725A 中 90%（58/64）和 TRF004A 中 50%（27/52）分别集中于 Chr10 和 Chr1
verified_claims.evidence: 7 (TS, T5αOH, T10βOH, T2αOH, T7βOH, T13αOH and DBAT) out of the 11 known genes were located on the chromosome 10… 90% (58 out of 64) of P450 genes in the CYP725A subfamily were expanded on this chromosome by tandem duplication (Figure 3B) and 50% genes (27 out of 52) in TRF004A subfamily were also expanded on the chromosome 1

verified_claims.claim: TS-2 与已知 TS 氨基酸一致性约 83%；来自 S. verticillata、P. chienii、T. wallichiana 的 4 个 TS 同源基因在酵母中可将 GGPP 转化为 taxadiene
verified_claims.evidence: we also identified a new duplicate of TS (TS-2)… which has about 83% amino acid identity… four TS genes from Sciadopitys verticillata, Pseudotaxus chienii, and T. wallichiana could convert GGPP into taxadiene

verified_claims.claim: TS 起源约 200 Mya（Cupressales 共同祖先），完整紫杉醇途径仅在 Taxaceae 共同祖先起源
verified_claims.evidence: the ability of cyclizing GGPP to taxadiene by TS genes had originated in the common ancestor of Cupressales around 200 Mya… the pathway of paclitaxel could have only originated in the common ancestor of Taxaceae

verified_claims.claim: CYP725A 第一次扩张约 180 Mya（T5αOH、T14βOH、T2αOH、T7βOH 分化，branch 2），第二次扩张约 150 Mya（T10βOH 出现，branch 3）
verified_claims.evidence: The first expansion happened in the common ancestor of Taxaceae around 180 Mya (Figure 3D), resulting in the functional differentiation of T5αOH, T14βOH, T2αOH and T7βOH (branch 2)… The second expansion occurred after the common ancestor of P. chienii and T. wallichiana diverged from Torreya grandis around 150 Mya (Figure 3D), resulting in the emergence of T10βOHs (branch 3)

verified_claims.claim: T5αOH-2 为新功能同工酶；28 个 CYP725A 未知基因与已知紫杉醇基因高度共表达
verified_claims.evidence: we also identified a new gene with the same function of T5αOH (T5αOH-2)… we also found that 28 unknown genes in CYP725A subfamily highly co-expressed with the known genes in paclitaxel biosynthetic pathway

verified_claims.claim: TRF004A 亚家族在 T. wallichiana 中保留特异疏水通道残基；模板 PDB 4KE4；SWISS-MODEL + Gromacs 100 ns MD；TAT 通道残基 38V/41S/42I/43F/349L/350D/351V/388Q/390E/391L
verified_claims.evidence: SWISSMODEL… The PDBID of template for TAT modelling was 4KE4. Based on the SWISSMODEL result, a 100ns molecular dynamics (MD) simulation was performed… residues 38V, 41S, 42I, 43F, 349L, 350D, 351V, 388Q, 390E and 391L were defined as the transport pathway residues

verified_claims.claim: 突变率 r = 2.2×10⁻⁹ 用于扩张时间 T=k/2r
verified_claims.evidence: T=k/2r, where 'k' represents the divergence distance… 'r' represents the mutation rate of substitution per site per year (2.2×10⁻⁹) (Nystedt et al., 2013)

verified_claims.claim: 共表达网络：21 个 RNA-seq 样本，11 个诱饵基因，Spearman>0.8 得到 484 共表达基因，最终 495 节点、11730 边，Cytoscape 3.7.1
verified_claims.evidence: 21 RNA-seq samples of taxus… 11 characterized paclitaxel biosynthetic genes… as the baits, 484 genes were found to be co-expressed with these 11 genes (Spearman correlation coefficient > 0.8)… 11730 co-expressed pairs (network edges). Finally, the co-expression network of the 495 genes was created by Cytoscape 3.7.1
